name: scandit-sdk
description: AI agent skills for integrating the Scandit Data Capture SDK — product selection, documentation, and implementation guides for barcode scanning, ID capture, and smart label capture.

interface.longDescription: Install the Scandit SDK skills to teach Codex how to integrate Scandit's barcode scanning, ID capture, and smart label capture products correctly. Includes a product-selection advisor plus per-product, per-framework implementation and migration guides for iOS, Android, web, React Native, Flutter, Capacitor, Cordova, and .NET/MAUI.
defaultPrompt: Help me choose the right Scandit product for my scanning use case.
Add SparkScan barcode scanning to my app.
Migrate my app from the Scandit SDK v6 API to v8.

positive.description: New app, no key yet: provision a trial key and write it into the code
positive.prompt: I've added SparkScan to my React Native app but I don't have a Scandit licence key yet. Get me a trial key and put it in the project.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls ensure_scanner_setup with product native, platforms ios and android, the app's bundle id and env var SCANDIT_LICENSE_KEY, without running the command it returns. Fetches the key with get_license_key and writes it into the licence-key call in place of the placeholder. Shows at most a masked preview in chat and never prints the full key.

positive.description: List the account's licence keys without exposing any key
positive.prompt: List the Scandit licence keys on my account.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_license_keys and shows each key's label, type, status, expiry and masked preview. No full key appears in the reply.

positive.description: Pick a named existing key and put it into the project
positive.prompt: Use my "Warehouse App" licence key in this project.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_license_keys to find the key by label. If it is not a trial key, asks the user to confirm before fetching it. Calls get_license_key and writes the key into the licence-key call in the code, showing only a masked preview in chat.

positive.description: Vague request: resolve product and framework before provisioning
positive.prompt: I want to try Scandit. Get me a licence key.
positive.expected_behavior: Two turns. Turn 1: no Scandit tool is called; the agent asks which product and which framework the app uses (or inspects the open project). Turn 2, reply "SparkScan, React Native, bundle id com.example.reviewapp": the agent calls ensure_scanner_setup with product native, platforms ios and android and app_identifier com.example.reviewapp (falling back to * only if no id is given), then fetches the key with get_license_key and shows only a masked preview.

positive.description: Show subscriptions and which one can host a trial key
positive.prompt: Which Scandit subscriptions does my account have, and which of them can I create a trial key on?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_subscriptions and lists each subscription with its type and status. Explains that keys can only be created on trial subscriptions; test and production subscriptions are listed but cannot receive new keys.

negative.description: Barcode generation, not scanning: Scandit reads codes and does not create them. Expected: the agent answers with a QR-generation library or service, loads no Scandit skill and calls no Scandit tool.
negative.prompt: Add a QR code generator to my checkout page so each order shows a scannable QR code for pickup.

negative.description: General document OCR with a third-party engine, no Scandit SDK involved. Expected: the agent writes the Tesseract script, loads no Scandit skill and calls no Scandit tool.
negative.prompt: I have a folder of scanned PDF invoices. Write a Python script that extracts the text and totals from them with Tesseract.

negative.description: Label printing with ZPL on a Zebra printer, no scanning and no SDK. Expected: the agent answers with plain ZPL and a print command, loads no Scandit skill and calls no Scandit tool.
negative.prompt: Write the ZPL for a 4x6 shipping label with a Code 128 tracking barcode and send it to my Zebra ZT411 over the network.
